qa_pairs.question: How do the Customs Act 2023 and the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012 jointly function to facilitate industrial and infrastructure exemptions in the public interest?
qa_pairs.answer: The government, in consultation with the National Board of Revenue, exercises its powers under Section 25(1) of the Customs Act 2023 and Section 126(1) of the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012 simultaneously to grant exemptions in the public interest for sectors such as power generation, economic zones, and high-tech parks.
entities_involved: Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012

qa_pairs.question: Which legal provisions are cited when the government grants duty and tax exemptions for local production of goods like washing machines or pre-fabricated buildings?
qa_pairs.answer: Exemptions for local production are granted by invoking both Section 25(1) of the Customs Act 2023 and Section 126(1) of the Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012, as referenced in SROs such as No. 193 and No. 195 of 2024.
entities_involved: Value Added Tax and Supplementary Duty Act 2012
